messages:
Lena (sales): Quick heads-up — Flagship Synapse POC: customer's CISO posted a long security questionnaire and is asking for KMS BYOK, VPC-only control plane, and per-tenant egress routing. Asking for executive signoff.
Riley (solutions): Thanks. Can someone paste the exact security asks? Need to scope effort & legal review. @Kumar @Tom FYI.
Kumar (infra): Key points: BYOK (HSM/KMS), VPC-private control plane + optional on-prem bundle, egress controls + IP allowlist. Also they want FIPS 140-2 attestation for KMS usage.
Tom (eng-runtime): Technically doable. BYOK requires key import flow + audit hooks; FIPS attestation is a legal/cert path, we can enable `kms_key_id` in config and add audit logs to Console. Perf note: private deployment with 4xA100 can do ~600 rps for short seqs; if they want low-99th latency we need Dedicated with reserved capacity.
Aisha (customer-success): Customer also asked for price delta for Dedicated vs Hosted + Private install. They're sensitive to per-token cost and committed spend.
Jen (finance): I'll draft a delta sheet. Need expected RPS, avg token lengths, and desired SLOs. Lena — can you drop those numbers?
Lena (sales): Tentative: 200 rps steady, 80 tokens/req avg, want 99th < 300ms. Exec call requested Friday 14:00 PT. Please confirm availability.
Riley (solutions): I'm on for Friday. Kumar — need an estimate of infra lift and time-to-deliver for Private.
Kumar (infra): Private deploy estimate: 4-6 weeks for on-prem full stack incl. legal/security signoffs. Shorter (2-3 weeks) for VPC option if they accept managed control plane.
Tom (eng-runtime): Will prepare a short tech slide showing perf numbers and fallback plan (model variants, quantization tradeoffs). Also include canary rollout + automatic fallback policy.
Jen (finance): Draft 1-pager and cost delta by EOD tomorrow.
Lena (sales): OK. Action items: Riley — security Qs & one-pager tech; Kumar — infra timeline + BYOK path; Tom — perf slides; Jen — cost delta. I'll schedule exec call and invite legal.
deploy-bot: Calendar booking created: 'Flagship Synapse POC — Exec Bridge' Friday 14:00 PT. Attendees: Lena, Riley, Kumar, Tom, Jen, Legal.
Lena (sales): Thanks — will loop in Legal and Solutions Architects. If anything blocks earlier, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
